title: Backend Engineer
jobText:
Lattice Works builds scheduling software for clinics.

What you'll do
- Build APIs in Node.js and TypeScript
- Own our PostgreSQL schema and queries
- Run background jobs with queues

What we're looking for
- 2+ years with Node.js
- Strong PostgreSQL
- Experience with job queues

Nice to have
- Kubernetes
- GraphQL

Salary £48,000–£55,000. Hybrid, Leeds. Closing date 30 November 2026.
